entities.name: Zea mays ferredoxin-3 P27788
observations: Exact 152-aa sequence match to reviewed UniProt P27788, chloroplastic ferredoxin-3 from Zea mays.
Annotated as an iron-sulfur electron-transfer protein; GO includes 2Fe-2S cluster binding and electron transfer activity.
Annotated localization: plastid/chloroplast, including chloroplast stroma; associated process: electron transport chain.
Pfam Fer2 domain PF00111.33 detected at residues 65–138.
